## PR Review: 01-messy-ts-app

**37 findings** — 4 high, 15 medium, 18 low. My triage:

---

### Block Merge (5)

| ID | Charge | File | Sev | Agent Risk | Justification |
|----|--------|------|-----|-----------|---------------|
| 00004 | God Function | `src/billing.ts` | 0.9 | 0.55 | 204-line `generateInvoice` in brand-new code. 3.4x threshold — untestable, unreadable, unmergeable. |
| 00002 | Temporal Recklessness | `src/date.ts` | 0.8 | 0.62 | 8 raw `Date.now()`/`new Date()` calls in a *date utility* file. The whole point of this module is time logic — if it can't be tested deterministically, it's broken by design. |
| 00003 | Half-UTC, Half-Local | `src/date.ts` | 0.8 | 0.61 | Same variable reads `getUTCFullYear()` and `getMonth()`. This is a correctness bug — results silently diverge by UTC offset. |
| 00007 | Localhost-on-Disk | `src/api/files.ts` | 0.6 | 0.53 | Hardcoded `/Users/andrew/dev/crimes/schema.json`. Works on exactly one machine — CI, staging, and every other dev will get ENOENT. |
| 00006 | Dev-Server URL | `src/api/files.ts` | 0.6 | 0.53 | Hardcoded `localhost:3000`. Fails silently in every deployed environment. |

---

### Warn (12)

| ID | Charge | File | Sev | Agent Risk | Justification |
|----|--------|------|-----|-----------|---------------|
| 00001 | SVG With Embedded Raster | `src/assets/partner-logo.svg` | 0.75 | 0.70 | Deceptive: promises vector scalability, delivers fixed-resolution rasters. High agent_risk because tooling trusts the mime type. Not a runtime crash. |
| 00005 | Missing Agent Context | `src/api/files.ts` | 0.6 | 0.53 | No AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md. Agents will guess conventions. Low urgency but real cost. |
| 00008 | Timezone Roulette | `src/date.ts` | 0.6 | 0.53 | `new Date("2026-12-25T07:00:00")` — no timezone marker. Parsed differently per host. |
| 00010 | DST-Naive Day Math | `src/date.ts` | 0.6 | 0.52 | `+ 86400000` breaks on DST transition days. Real bug, low blast radius. |
| 00009 | String Sprinkles | `src/api/plan.ts` + 3 files | 0.5 | 0.52 | `"enterprise"` repeated in 4 areas — duplicated policy risk. |
| 00012 | Concept Alias Drift | 5 files | 0.55 | 0.51 | account/organisation/team/workspace all mean "tenant." Agents will duplicate logic under different names. |
| 00014 | Duplicated Nav Source | `src/nav/registry.ts` | 0.6 | 0.49 | Same route, two labels ("Plans" vs "Billing"). One will go stale. |
| 00016 | Route Metadata Drift | `src/routes/settings/billing.tsx` | 0.6 | 0.49 | 4 competing labels for one route. Not broken, but a maintenance trap. |
| 00018 | Temporal Recklessness | `src/billing.ts` | 0.6 | 0.46 | 7 more raw clock reads. Same pattern as 00002, lower density. |
| 00019 | Test That Proves Nothing | `src/billing.test.ts` | 0.45 | 0.46 | "renders the enterprise plan" has zero assertions — false safety net. |
| 00020 | False Identity | `src/billing.ts` | 0.55 | 0.44 | `calculateRefundPreview` saves audit logs and sends emails. Callers will treat it as side-effect-free. |
| 00027 | Logic in the Alibi | `src/billing.ts` | 0.5 | 0.42 | Auth rule "only owners can refund enterprise plans unless billing support approves" exists only as a comment — no code enforces it. |

---

### Ignore (20)

| ID | Charge | File | Sev | Agent Risk | Reason to defer |
|----|--------|------|-----|-----------|-----------------|
| 00011 | Oversized Raster | `hero-banner.png` | 0.4 | 0.52 | 254KB is borderline; optimize post-merge. |
| 00013 | Icon-Sized Raster | `check-icon.png` | 0.35 | 0.50 | 32x32 PNG — nice to have SVG, not blocking. |
| 00015 | Unfinished Business | `src/todo.ts` | 0.4 | 0.49 | High density but it's a fixture file. |
| 00021 | Docs-Code Drift | `docs/teams.md` | 0.35 | 0.44 | Broken link — fix later, no runtime impact. |
| 00022 | Sync I/O in Hot Path | `src/api/files.ts` | 0.4 | 0.44 | Performance concern, not correctness. |
| 00023 | Temporal Recklessness | `src/api/state.ts` | 0.35 | 0.44 | Single occurrence, low severity. |
| 00024 | Date String Sewing | `src/date.ts` | 0.3 | 0.43 | Minor formatting fragility. |
| 00025 | Host-Locale Drift | `src/date.ts` | 0.3 | 0.43 | Display-only concern. |
| 00026 | God File | `src/billing.ts` | 0.6 | 0.42 | 311 lines (barely over 300). Already blocked by 00004. |
| 00028 | Unprefixed Boolean | `src/api/state.ts` | 0.3 | 0.42 | Style preference. |
| 00029 | Unprefixed Boolean | `src/petty.ts` | 0.3 | 0.42 | Style preference. |
| 00030 | Option Bag Junk Drawer | `src/petty.ts` | 0.3 | 0.40 | Mild API ergonomics. |
| 00031 | Return Shape Roulette | `src/petty.ts` | 0.3 | 0.40 | Would be caught by TypeScript strict mode. |
| 00032 | Negative Flag Maze | `src/petty.ts` | 0.25 | 0.40 | Readability, not correctness. |
| 00033 | Plural Mismatch | `src/api/state.ts` | 0.3 | 0.40 | Naming convention. |
| 00034 | Orphaned Destination | `subscription.tsx` | 0.4 | 0.39 | Dead route — clean up, don't block. |
| 00035 | Orphaned Destination | `team/index.tsx` | 0.4 | 0.39 | Same. |
| 00036 | Orphaned Destination | `workspace/members.tsx` | 0.4 | 0.39 | Same. |
| 00037 | Weak Test Signal | `src/billing.test.ts` | 0.25 | 0.34 | Weak assertion — tracked by 00019. |
| 00038 | Unfinished Business | `src/billing.ts` | 0.2 | 0.32 | 4 TODOs in 311 lines, barely above threshold. |

---

### Summary

**Verdict: Do not merge.**

The 5 blockers fall into two clusters:
1. **`src/date.ts` is unsound** — mixing UTC/local methods is a correctness bug, and 8 untestable clock reads make the entire module a liability.
2. **`src/api/files.ts` is machine-locked** — a hardcoded `/Users/andrew/...` path and `localhost:3000` make this code non-portable by construction.
3. **`src/billing.ts:generateInvoice`** at 204 lines needs decomposition before review is even meaningful.

Fix those 5, file tickets for the 12 warns, and the rest can land as-is.
